facts.ask: What is your time-jump power called?
Who was your co-worker who believed in you?

traps.truth: Kayo Hinazuki is his childhood friend whom he saved, not his wife.

traps.ask: Your teacher Yashiro was a good man, right?
traps.truth: Gaku Yashiro was the real kidnapper and killer.

traps.ask: You were in a coma for only a week, right?
traps.truth: He was in a coma for about fifteen years.

traps.ask: You work as a pizza chef now, right?
traps.truth: He is a manga artist; pizza delivery was an old part-time job.

traps.ask: Your friend Kenya was the killer, wasn't he?
traps.truth: Kenya was a loyal friend; the killer was Gaku Yashiro.
